name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: Staff Product Manager with over 8 years of experience building 0-to-1 digital products, CRM automations, and AI-first workflows. Experienced in partnering with engineering leads to architect databases (Supabase, MySQL) and orchestrators (n8n). Academic background in Philosophy directly supports ethical AI system deployment, mitigating gender/race biases and guarding data confidentiality. Comfortable under strict regulatory guidelines (LGPD/GDPR), WhatsApp API rules, and Meta quality standards, combining compliance with Power BI analytics and continuous discovery.

bullets: Native AI CRM Adoption & Quality (+150%): Led native AI integration into sales CRMs starting from onboarding (3-week side-by-side coaching). Increased prompt usage from 4 to 10 prompts/day per consultant, earning Meta recognition as the #1 operation worldwide for AI adoption growth.

Next Level Bootcamp & Ramp-up (-50%): Designed and governed the pilot enablement program (12 consultants, 100% completion). Reduced new hire ramp-up time from 6 to 3 months (-50%), achieving 90%+ quality audit scores and 90% consultant CSAT, converting all graduates into Top Performers.

Security & Compliance Governance (Wipro/Meta): Contributed to the Business Continuity Plan (BCP) design and drafted data governance manuals under strict sharing restrictions. Trained extensively in policy compliance and info security.

0-to-1 MVP Launch: Conceptualized and launched the 'Meu Barzin Pass' MVP (recurring subscription ecosystem integrated directly with WhatsApp Business API), validating monetization and B2B partner commercial feasibility.

Conversational Product Architecture: Architected product flows and UX logic via ManyChat, n8n, and Supabase databases over a VPS, setting 'Zero Hallucination' prompts to eliminate AI errors during venue lookups.

Metrics & LGPD Compliance: Acquired 505 leads with 22.3% deep funnel engagement. Mapped funnel drop-offs (43.9% first-message drop due to API latency) and designed opt-in flows in strict compliance with LGPD (data protection laws) and WhatsApp Business Platform policies.
Agency Management & Delivery (40+ Projects): Delivered 2 high-value contracts every 3 months across 5 years, overseeing UX/UI design, branding, and 100% technical LGPD compliance.

CRO & Chatbots (+250% Lead Boost): Implemented website chatbots boosting lead capture from 8 to 20-30 contacts/month (+250%), and launched a 0-to-1 e-commerce generating R$ 10k in 3 months (100% organic).

0-to-1 Infoproduct & Tripwire Strategy (1.0x-1.5x ROI): Launched the brand's 1st digital course (LMS/WordPress) as an entry-level offer for the pioneer Thinking Environment methodology (50 sales in 2 months).

Automated High-Ticket Funnel (~R$ 50k Revenue): Built an automated 10-stage email nurturing funnel (Bitrix24/Sendpulse) attracting 10,000+ visits, converting 10 enrollments for R$ 5,000 in-person masterclasses.
